answer_1.quote: We fine-tuned pre-trained LLMs to make MTs from 39 Brazilian Indigenous languages (BILs) to English.
answer_1.outputs: English translations of Indigenous language sentences

answer_2.quote: We used three metrics to evaluate the results, combining the traditional BLEU score with more recent neural-based metrics which are considered to be more robust and better correlated with human scores ... BLEURT and BERTScore.
